cardDescription.en: Try on any installed skin live in the GUI — exit restores instantly, applying persists in one click.
cardDescription.zh: 在 GUI 内即时试穿任意皮肤，退出即完全还原；应用一键完成并自动刷新。

externalWallpaperReadyTitle.en: Wallpapers are handled by another plugin
externalWallpaperReadyTitle.zh: 壁纸已由独立插件接管

externalWallpaperReadyBody.en: Wallpaper Engine support comes from the {package} plugin, which owns the wallpaper library, rendering and settings. While it renders a wallpaper it takes over the backdrop, and this card keeps the skin on top of it: the skin's own background art steps aside and the composer frost yields to the plugin's glass.
externalWallpaperReadyBody.zh: Wallpaper Engine 壁纸来自 {package} 插件，壁纸库、渲染与设置都归它管。它渲染壁纸时会接管背景，本卡片让皮肤叠在其之上：皮肤自身的背景图让路，输入卡磨砂也让给该插件的玻璃。

externalWallpaperMissingTitle.en: Wallpaper Engine support moved to its own plugin
externalWallpaperMissingTitle.zh: Wallpaper Engine 支持已独立成插件

externalWallpaperMissingBody.en: This card no longer bundles a Wallpaper Engine bridge. To use Wallpaper Engine wallpapers, install {package} with the command below and restart dsh; it adds its own settings page for the wallpaper library, rendering and glass.
externalWallpaperMissingBody.zh: 本卡片不再自带 Wallpaper Engine 桥。要使用 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸，请用下面的命令安装 {package} 并重启 dsh；它自带壁纸库、渲染与玻璃的设置页。

delegatedSkinDescriptionClaudeStyle.en: The whole GUI as Claude Code Desktop: warm ivory canvas, serif body text, the ember accent, a pixel mascot on the composer and the chat-area behaviours Claude Code is known for. Its own settings page stays reachable while another skin is on screen.
delegatedSkinDescriptionClaudeStyle.zh: 整副界面就是 Claude Code Desktop：暖米色画布、衬线正文、余烬橙强调色、输入框上沿的像素吉祥物，以及 Claude Code 那些对话区交互。它自带的设置页在别的皮肤在屏时照常可用。

delegatedSkinNotRunning.en: The plugin is installed but not running here. Enable it in Plugins, then reopen this page.
delegatedSkinNotRunning.zh: 插件已安装但当前页面没有运行。请在「插件」中启用它，然后刷新本页。

delegatedSkinNoHandoff.en: The running plugin build cannot hand the page back to a skin, so it cannot be selected from here. Update dsh-claude-style.
delegatedSkinNoHandoff.zh: 当前运行的插件版本无法在皮肤之间让出页面，因此这里不能选用它。请更新 dsh-claude-style。

delegatedSkinDescriptorMismatch.en: The installed plugin declares a different skin id or attribute than this card knows. Update the plugin.
delegatedSkinDescriptorMismatch.zh: 已安装的插件声明的皮肤 id 或属性与本卡片记录的不一致，请更新插件。

stoodDownTitle.en: Skin paused while the wallpaper is active
stoodDownTitle.zh: 壁纸启用期间皮肤已暂停

stoodDownBody.en: Your skin is still selected, but it is not painted while the wallpaper plugin renders a wallpaper: the two cannot share the backdrop. Stop the wallpaper there and the skin comes back on its own.
stoodDownBody.zh: 你选择的皮肤仍然保留，但在壁纸插件渲染壁纸期间不会绘制：两者的背景无法共存。在该插件里停止壁纸，皮肤会自动恢复。

enabledHint.en: When off, try-on, apply and background controls are disabled; turn it back on to resume.
enabledHint.zh: 关闭后停用试穿、应用与背景控件，重新打开即恢复。

offNote.en: The skin center is turned off.

intro.en: Try on any skin live — it takes effect instantly, exit restores the current look. Apply persists it across restarts.
intro.zh: 任意皮肤可即时试穿，退出即完全还原；「应用」一键持久化，页面自动刷新生效。

officialTagline.en: The stock DSH look with no skin applied.
officialTagline.zh: 还原 DSH 官方默认外观，不应用任何皮肤。

appliedUnconfirmed.en: Applied, but the change has not been confirmed — refresh the page in dev mode; packaged installs (DSH Desktop) need an app restart
appliedUnconfirmed.zh: 已写入配置但尚未确认生效——开发模式请刷新页面；打包版（DSH Desktop）需重启应用后生效

appliedNeedRestart.en: Applied and confirmed, but the host did not hot-reload — restart dsh to take effect
appliedNeedRestart.zh: 已写入配置并确认生效，但宿主未热重载——请重启 dsh 后生效

inputCardBlurHint.en: Blurs only the area behind the input card while backdrop art is visible; it does not blur the entire wallpaper.
inputCardBlurHint.zh: 仅模糊输入卡背后的区域，不会让整张壁纸变糊。

bubbleOpacityHint.en: Controls translucent message bubbles for skins that expose bubble alpha, such as Whale Mom.
bubbleOpacityHint.zh: 调节支持气泡 alpha 的皮肤消息气泡，例如鲸鱼妈妈。

bubbleBlurHint.en: Blurs the backdrop behind translucent message bubbles; independent of bubble opacity, 0 disables.
bubbleBlurHint.zh: 模糊半透明消息气泡背后的区域，与「气泡不透明度」相互独立，0 为关闭。

backgroundBlurHint.en: Applies a separate Gaussian blur to the backdrop for the empty conversation and the conversation with content; 0 disables.
backgroundBlurHint.zh: 对话为空与有内容时分别应用不同的背景高斯模糊强度，0 为关闭。

backgroundBlurInert.en: Visible only with skins that paint a backdrop; the official default has none.
backgroundBlurInert.zh: 仅对带背景图插画的皮肤可见；官方默认无背景图。

backgroundHint.en: Instantly veils the backdrop behind the panels — higher values obscure the art to help you focus.
backgroundHint.zh: 即时为面板背后的背景加遮罩——数值越高越能弱化插画，帮你集中注意力。

backgroundHintInert.en: Only applies to skins that paint a backdrop (Blue Fantasy / Whale Song). Applies to the official default automatically once such a skin is active.
backgroundHintInert.zh: 仅对带背景图插画的皮肤（蓝色幻想 / 鲸吟）生效；官方默认无背景图，该滑块对这些皮肤自动生效。

wallpaperHint.en: Use your local Wallpaper Engine library as the GUI backdrop: video, web, and scene wallpapers render live (scene wallpapers need WebGL). On macOS there is no Wallpaper Engine library, so the feature starts off — turn it on, then add a folder of videos.
wallpaperHint.zh: 把本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库用作 GUI 背景：视频、网页与场景壁纸均动态渲染（场景壁纸需要 WebGL）。macOS 没有 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库，该功能默认关闭；开启后添加一个存放视频的目录即可。

wallpaperLibraryFound.zh: 已检测到 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库

wallpaperSoundHint.en: Play video wallpaper audio. The browser may keep it silent until you click or press a key once.
wallpaperSoundHint.zh: 播放视频壁纸的声音。浏览器可能在首次点击或按键前保持静音。

wallpaperImportHint.en: Copy this wallpaper into local storage, so it keeps working even if the Steam library moves or changes
wallpaperImportHint.zh: 把该壁纸复制到本地存储，Steam 库迁移或变动后仍可继续使用

wallpaperUpdateAvailable.en: The workshop original changed since import — update the local copy
wallpaperUpdateAvailable.zh: 工坊原件在导入后有更新——同步更新本地副本

wallpaperEmpty.en: No wallpapers found. Add a folder of videos below, or subscribe in the Wallpaper Engine workshop on Windows.
wallpaperEmpty.zh: 未发现壁纸。请在下方添加一个存放视频的目录；Windows 上也可先在 Wallpaper Engine 创意工坊订阅。

wallpaperDirsEmpty.en: No folders yet — add one to load its videos.
wallpaperDirsEmpty.zh: 还没有目录——添加一个以加载其中的视频。

wallpaperDirsHint.en: On macOS: pick a folder of .mp4/.webm videos (or a wallpaper project folder). On Windows, folders extend the auto-detected Wallpaper Engine library.
wallpaperDirsHint.zh: macOS：选择一个存放 .mp4/.webm 视频的目录（或单个壁纸项目文件夹）。Windows：这里添加的目录会扩展自动检测到的 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库。

wallpaperDirBrowseHint.en: Pick a folder with the system file manager (Finder / Explorer)
wallpaperDirBrowseHint.zh: 通过系统文件管理器（访达 / 资源管理器）选择文件夹

wallpaperDirBrowseFailed.en: Could not open the system folder picker — type the path manually instead
wallpaperDirBrowseFailed.zh: 无法打开系统目录选择框——请手动输入路径

wallpaperDirBrowseTruncated.en: Too many folders to list; only the beginning is shown.
wallpaperDirBrowseTruncated.zh: 目录过多，仅显示开头部分。

customThemeTagline.en: A separately saved palette derived from the official default theme.
customThemeTagline.zh: 基于官方默认主题生成并独立保存的配色方案。

customThemeResetHint.en: Only resets the selected light or dark profile.
customThemeResetHint.zh: 只重置当前选择的浅色或深色配置。

customThemeSaveFailed.en: Could not save custom theme changes.
customThemeSaveFailed.zh: 自定义主题修改保存失败。

uninstallConfirm.en: Are you sure you want to uninstall "{name}"? Local files will be deleted.
uninstallConfirm.zh: 确定要卸载皮肤「{name}」吗？本地文件将被永久删除。

verifyAllPassed.en: All {count} installed skin(s) passed integrity verification
verifyAllPassed.zh: 所有 {count} 款已安装皮肤完整性正常

verifyFoundIssues.zh: 发现 {count} 款皮肤存在完整性异常

verifyRepaired.en: Successfully repaired {count} skin(s) with integrity issues
verifyRepaired.zh: 已自动修复 {count} 款皮肤的完整性异常

updateAllNone.en: All installed skins are up to date
updateAllNone.zh: 所有已安装皮肤均为最新版本

uninstallAllConfirm.en: Uninstall all {count} market-installed skin(s)? Their local files are deleted permanently and the GUI returns to the default look.
uninstallAllConfirm.zh: 确定要卸载全部 {count} 款市场安装的皮肤吗？本地文件将被永久删除，界面回到默认外观。

marketUnreachable.en: Could not reach the skin market to read versions
marketUnreachable.zh: 无法连接皮肤市场以读取版本

bulkNoUserSkins.en: No market-installed skins to act on
bulkNoUserSkins.zh: 没有可操作的市场安装皮肤
